title: Account-aware Security Intake Scorer and SLA Estimator
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Problem: Enterprise customers submit a high volume of security/compliance asks (SOC2 evidence, DPAs, GDPR data residency questions, HIPAA support, vendor questionnaires). Triage today is manual, inconsistent across accounts, and does not provide realistic SLA commitments during sales conversations. Goal: Build an account-aware intake scorer that synthesizes request metadata, customer profile (contract tier, industry, region), and historical resolution times to produce a prioritized score and a recommended SLA estimate. This will power a priority lane in the intake UI, an auto-response with an expected SLA range for sales and CS, and a routing hint for the security team. Out of scope for this ticket: automating full evidence collection or policy exemptions. Success metrics: 40% reduction in manual labeling time for new requests, 20% fewer SLA renegotiations post-commit, and >80% alignment between estimated SLA and actual resolution within the estimated window.
acceptance_criteria: Scoring model implemented server-side that consumes request type, account tier, industry, data residency requirements, and risk flags
Intake UI displays priority score (0-100), recommended SLA band, and rationale summary for reviewers
Auto-email template generated that includes estimated SLA band when front-line submits a request
Routing hints (security queue, legal review, high-touch CS) surfaced to intake triage team
Metrics surfaced to dashboard: predicted SLA vs actual resolution time, misclassification rate, and time-to-assignment
Security review completed and sign-off recorded in ticket before release
updates: 2025-02-10 - Kickoff: Scope defined with Security, CS, and Sales; initial dataset targets identified (security questionnaires, DPAs, SOC2 requests)
2025-02-18 - Data review meeting: Found inconsistent taxonomy across incoming requests; agreed to normalize request_type and add 'sensitive_data' boolean in pipeline
2025-02-24 - Prototype scoring prototype completed (heuristic rules + simple weighted features). Demoed to Security; received feedback to weight account contract tier more heavily
2025-03-01 - UX spike: Intake UI mockups completed; PM/Design flagged space constraints for rationale text; decided on hover-expansion for full rationale
2025-03-04 - Engineering spike: Backend endpoint and queue routing hooks implemented (staging). Added feature flags for rollout and telemetry collection
2025-03-05 - Integration: Hooked score output into auto-response draft; Security requested audit log entries for score provenance; added to acceptance criteria
notes: Design trade-off: short rationale vs. transparency. Chose short rationale with link-to-full because sales prefers concise SLAs in first-touch emails.
Trade-off: model complexity vs explainability. Start with feature-weighted linear scorer; evaluate ML model in Q3 if accuracy plateau.
Follow-ups: Add account churn risk as signal for escalation in next iteration (connect to RevOps data)
Edge cases: air-gapped/private deployments may require manual evidence routing; flag created for Private customers
